name: Mistral Compute / AI Cloud

modes.label: Dedicated AI capacity
modes.note: No public price exists (no EUR or USD list price, no FX conversion applied). Sales-only reserved/dedicated NVIDIA GB200/GB300/B300 capacity in the EU ('Reserve AI compute capacity in Europe for long-term growth'); every rate is null. VAT basis unknown.

plans.name: Reserved capacity (contact sales)
plans.note: Unknown quotas are not confirmed unlimited.

caveats: Compute list price, currency, minimum commitment, GPU SKU and ordinary CPU availability unknown.
Unknowns remain null, not free; generic infrastructure modes are opt-in alt.
Worked example assumes resources are released between active windows unless a retained-instance scenario is explicitly discussed.
VAT basis: Unknown: reviewed pricing source does not explicitly establish VAT/tax inclusion.
Residency: European dedicated capacity marketed; exact contracted facility, data control and subprocessor scope require contract.

Status 2026-09-29: live. Product now marketed as 'Mistral AI Cloud' (mistral.ai/products/mistral-compute redirects to /products/aicloud/). Timeline on the page: GB200 serving production Feb 2026, first external customers onboarded Mar 2026. The AI Cloud page also sells Regional Endpoints / Priority Tier model inference (token-priced, not a sandbox/VM) and SLURM-based cluster access; no per-GPU-hour, per-vCPU or storage/egress price is published anywhere.

fleet.notes: Dedicated GPU infrastructure is presented as an enterprise/private Mistral-operated environment. No numeric new self-serve quota, verification checklist or capacity-approval turnaround established.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

isolation.quote: Reserve dedicated, high-performance GPUs in Europe, without having to source, build, or operate infrastructure.
isolation.note: Product is sold as dedicated/reserved GPU racks (GB200/GB300/B300) per customer with Managed Slurm or Managed Kubernetes on top, not a shared multi-tenant hypervisor sandbox; derived from 'dedicated' capacity framing, not an explicit isolation-technology statement.

byoc.note: Infrastructure is Mistral-operated (Mistral's own EU data centers/racks), not deployed into the customer's own cloud account.

open_source.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; the Mistral Compute platform/orchestration stack is proprietary (Mistral's own models are open-weight, but that is a separate product line)

hipaa.note: Listed as a compliance document on Mistral's org-wide Trust Center; not confirmed as Compute-specific (BAA availability not itemized per product).

max_session_h.quote: Reserve AI compute capacity in Europe for long-term growth. Gain dedicated access with the scale, continuity, and control to execute your AI strategy.
max_session_h.note: Capacity is reserved/dedicated for the contract term (long-term growth), not a per-session time limit; jobs run under customer-managed Slurm/Kubernetes scheduling with no provider-imposed session cap documented.

snapshot.quote: Compute High-performance NVIDIA GPUs in Europe for demanding training and inference, without sourcing, building, or operating the hardware yourself.
snapshot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — this is dedicated/reserved SLURM-scheduled GPU capacity for training/inference jobs, not a sandbox/VM product with snapshot/restore semantics.

snapshot_auto.quote: Compute High-performance NVIDIA GPUs in Europe for demanding training and inference, without sourcing, building, or operating the hardware yourself.
snapshot_auto.note: not offered: outside the product's scope (dedicated reserved capacity billed for the contract term, not a stop/sleep sandbox model).

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Compute High-performance NVIDIA GPUs in Europe for demanding training and inference, without sourcing, building, or operating the hardware yourself.
snapshot_on_demand.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; no API/CLI snapshot/checkpoint capability is documented.

pause_resume.quote: Reserve AI compute capacity in Europe for long-term growth. Gain dedicated access with the scale, continuity, and control to execute your AI strategy.
pause_resume.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — capacity is reserved/contracted (sales-only), not billed per-instance with a pause/resume state; SLURM job suspend is a scheduler concept, not a billing pause feature.

persistent_disk.quote: Governance. SSO and SCIM out of the box. RBAC maps to SLURM accounts. Secrets, key management, audit trails, CI/CD webhooks.
persistent_disk.note: derived: SLURM HPC clusters standardly provide a persistent shared parallel filesystem across the cluster's lifetime; not explicitly documented for Mistral Compute specifically.

volume_shared.note: derived: SLURM-based HPC/GPU clusters conventionally mount a shared cluster-wide filesystem across all compute nodes; not explicitly stated on the page.

lang_python.quote: Frontier-grade compute for the most demanding AI workloads. Yours to build on. Run models, serve production workloads, and access dedicated compute in one place.
lang_python.note: derived: AI training/inference workloads on GPU clusters (Mistral's own model stack) are run in Python/PyTorch by convention; not itemized as a discrete feature on the page.

lang_node.quote: Compute High-performance NVIDIA GPUs in Europe for demanding training and inference, without sourcing, building, or operating the hardware yourself.
lang_node.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a SLURM-scheduled GPU training/inference cluster is not marketed or documented as a Node.js runtime target.

inbound_https.quote: Compute High-performance NVIDIA GPUs in Europe for demanding training and inference, without sourcing, building, or operating the hardware yourself.
inbound_https.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — this is dedicated GPU training/inference capacity accessed via SLURM/APIs, not a sandbox that exposes per-job public HTTPS endpoints.

egress_http_rules.quote: Compute High-performance NVIDIA GPUs in Europe for demanding training and inference, without sourcing, building, or operating the hardware yourself.
egress_http_rules.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no HTTP method/path-level egress control is documented for this dedicated GPU/SLURM cluster product.

nested_virt.quote: a private, integrated stack—GPUs, orchestration, APIs, products, and services in whatever form factor they need, from bare-metal servers to fully-managed PaaS
nested_virt.note: derived: Mistral Compute explicitly offers bare-metal server access (not just a locked-down PaaS layer); on real bare-metal hardware /dev/kvm and nested virtualization are available to the customer's own OS. Not itemized as a discrete 'nested_virt' feature on any page.

egress_ip_type.quote: Security. Purpose-built security for large-scale AI workloads: EVPN-VXLAN network isolation, AES-256 encryption at rest with BYOK, and defined data wiping protocol.
egress_ip_type.note: derived: this is dedicated GPU capacity in Mistral-operated EU data centers with EVPN-VXLAN network isolation; outbound traffic originates from Mistral's own EU datacenter IP ranges, not a residential/mobile proxy pool. No explicit statement of egress IP type.

ssh.quote: a private, integrated stack—GPUs, orchestration, APIs, products, and services in whatever form factor they need, from bare-metal servers to fully-managed PaaS
ssh.note: derived: bare-metal server access plus 'Managed Slurm' (mistral.ai/compute: 'Schedule and run large-scale training and HPC workloads without setting up or operating the cluster yourself') conventionally exposes SSH to login/compute nodes for job submission and interactive access; not explicitly documented as an 'SSH' feature.

volume_attach.quote: Reserve dedicated, high-performance GPUs in Europe, without having to source, build, or operate infrastructure.
volume_attach.note: not offered: outside the product's scope as documented — this is a sales-only reserved-capacity contract with a shared cluster filesystem (RBAC maps to SLURM accounts), not a self-serve API/console to attach or detach extra block-storage volumes per machine.

public_ipv4.quote: Security. Purpose-built security for large-scale AI workloads: EVPN-VXLAN network isolation, AES-256 encryption at rest with BYOK, and defined data wiping protocol.
public_ipv4.note: derived: EVPN-VXLAN network isolation describes a private, segmented cluster network for training/inference nodes; no public-IPv4-per-machine capability is documented, consistent with a Slurm/Kubernetes-scheduled dedicated cluster rather than a public-IP VM product.

ingress_rules.quote: Security. Purpose-built security for large-scale AI workloads: EVPN-VXLAN network isolation, AES-256 encryption at rest with BYOK, and defined data wiping protocol.
ingress_rules.note: not offered: outside the product's scope as documented — the product is a private, network-isolated training/inference cluster (Slurm/Kubernetes jobs), not a platform that publishes a per-port ingress-control mechanism (private URLs, IP allowlists, security groups) for exposed services.

guest_firewall.quote: a private, integrated stack—GPUs, orchestration, APIs, products, and services in whatever form factor they need, from bare-metal servers to fully-managed PaaS
guest_firewall.note: derived: bare-metal server access implies root-level control of the OS, so nftables/iptables would function inside; per field definition guidance for a full VM/bare-metal with root=true. Not explicitly documented.

static_egress_ip.quote: Reserve AI compute capacity in Europe for long-term growth. Gain dedicated access with the scale, continuity, and control to execute your AI strategy.
static_egress_ip.note: derived: capacity is dedicated/reserved long-term for a single customer (not a shared, dynamically-recycled fleet), so the allocated network range and its outbound IP would be fixed for the contract term; not explicitly stated as a 'static egress IP' feature.

usage_api.quote: Reserve AI compute capacity in Europe for long-term growth. Gain dedicated access with the scale, continuity, and control to execute your AI strategy.
usage_api.note: granularity: account-only; cost: no; Product is sold as reserved/dedicated GPU capacity (GB200/GB300/B300) via sales-only contract with Managed Slurm/Kubernetes orchestration. No public per-sandbox usage metering API is documented. Billing is contract-based for capacity reservation, not per-resource consumption.
